plain: The formal breaking up or ending of a group, assembly, or union

webster.text: In a general sense, the separation of the parts of a body which, in the natural structure, are united; or the reduction of concrete bodies into their smallest parts, without regard to solidity or fluidity.

more.text: The act of liquefying or changing from a solid to a fluid state by heat; a melting; a thawing; as the dissolution of snow and ice, which converts them into water.
Death; the separation of the soul and body.
Destruction; the separation of the parts which compose a connected system, or body; as the dissolution of the world, or of nature; the dissolution of government.
The breaking up of an assembly, or the putting an end to its existence.

example.quote: There still are discordant and undecided claims between several of them, and the dissolution of the Union would lay a foundation for similar claims between them all.
